name: Chatics – AI Chatbot Widget for WordPress (n8n Powered)
author: Apselo

sections.description:
Chatics is a free WordPress plugin that adds a customizable AI chatbot widget to your website and connects it to your n8n workflows through a public webhook. With Chatics you can launch an AI-powered chat assistant, customer support bot, or lead-capture widget in minutes without writing a single line of code.

The chat widget floats on every page and talks directly to the conversational logic you build in n8n, so you stay in full control of your AI agent, data, and integrations.

View the Chatics homepage » | Get support »

What can you build with Chatics?

  • AI customer support chat: answer questions 24/7 using OpenAI/GPT agents via n8n
  • Lead capture & CRM bots: push leads to FluentCRM, Pabbly, HubSpot, or Google Sheets
  • Booking & appointment assistants: let AI handle scheduling
  • Automation-driven assistants: trigger emails, webhooks, and external APIs from chat
  • Workflow orchestration: connect chat to any tool n8n supports

Why choose Chatics?

Most chatbot plugins lock you into one AI provider or a paid SaaS backend. Chatics is different: it is a lightweight, open bridge between WordPress and your own n8n workflow, so you decide which AI model runs, where your data goes, and how the conversation behaves. It is free, translation-ready, and built to stay out of your way.

✨ Key Features

  • Embed any public n8n webhook into your site
  • Upload a custom SVG or PNG chat icon
  • Choose button position (left or right)
  • Set your own chat title and widget color
  • Adjust the zoom level of the chat iframe
  • Full-screen mode for an immersive chat experience
  • Show or hide the chat header
  • Use the WordPress media uploader for icon selection
  • Default fallback icon included
  • Display the chatbot only on selected days and working hours
  • Clean, fast, and easy to configure
  • Translation-ready (.pot file included)

How to Get Your n8n Chat URL

  1. Set up a workflow in n8n using the Chat Trigger node.
  2. Connect it to an AI agent or OpenAI/GPT node.
  3. Enable “Make Chat Publicly Available” in the trigger node.
  4. Set the mode to “Hosted Chat” (recommended).
  5. Copy the Webhook URL and paste it into the plugin settings.

Links

  • Plugin Homepage
  • Support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/chatics directory, or install directly from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Chatics and configure your chat options.
  4. Make sure your n8n webhook is set to Public or uses Hosted Chat mode.
  5. Save your settings and your AI chatbot will appear on your site!

For a full setup walkthrough, visit the Chatics documentation.
sections.faq:
What is Chatics?

Chatics is a free WordPress plugin that adds a customizable AI chatbot widget to your site and connects it to your n8n workflow through a public webhook. It lets you run AI chat, support bots, and automation directly on WordPress.

Is Chatics free?

Yes. Chatics is a free, open-source plugin licensed under GPLv2 or later.

Do I need n8n to use Chatics?

Yes. n8n powers the chatbot logic. Chatics is the WordPress widget that connects your site to an n8n workflow, so an n8n webhook URL is required.

Does this plugin support self-hosted n8n?

Yes. Simply use your publicly accessible n8n webhook URL both n8n Cloud and self-hosted instances work.

Can I use any AI model with Chatics?

Yes. Because the AI logic lives in your n8n workflow, you can connect OpenAI/GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or any model n8n supports.

Is my chat data secure?

Chatics does not store conversations on your WordPress site. Messages are sent to your own n8n webhook, so you control where the data is processed and stored.

Can I trigger other actions from the chat?

Absolutely. Through n8n you can trigger email, webhooks, external APIs, CRM updates, Google Sheets, and more.

Is Chatics translatable?

Yes. A .pot file is included, and you can translate it using Loco Translate or WPML.

Where can I get support?

Visit our support page or post in the WordPress.org plugin support forum.
